marissa (People Ops): @here Quick heads up — SF HQ elevator modernization is scheduled Mon 2026-05-04 through Thu 2026-05-07. Primary elevator bank (A) will be intermittently offline each day roughly 07:00–18:00.

marissa (People Ops): If you need step-free/ADA access during those hours please reply with the date(s) and a 30min window so we can reserve the service elevator for you. We have a limited number of service-trips each hour.

marissa (People Ops): Logistics highlights: :point_right:
• Shuttle from Mission BART to HQ 08:00–10:00 and 16:00–18:30 (details below)
• Parking entrance temporarily moved to Lot C (north side) — signage will be out
• Deliveries: please route all packages to loading dock B between 07:30–09:30 or 18:00–19:30
• Onsite trainings scheduled that week: please alert People Ops if participants will arrive with large equipment

marissa (People Ops): Transit stipend: $15 each direction for folks who normally commute to the office — expense code elevator-2026 in Expensify. For reimbursables, include a screenshot of your ride or ticket.

marissa (People Ops): Catering: Wednesday lunch will be provided between 12:00–13:30 near the cafeteria. If you have dietary restrictions, DM me.

marissa (People Ops): Shuttle schedule (subject to small delays):
```
Mission BART -> Redwood HQ (North Entrance)
08:00 depart, 08:20 arrive
08:30 depart, 08:50 arrive
09:00 depart, 09:20 arrive

Redwood HQ -> Mission BART
16:00 depart, 16:20 arrive
17:00 depart, 17:20 arrive
18:00 depart, 18:20 arrive
```

marissa (People Ops): If you rely on elevator access daily (mobility, pregnancy, injury, heavy equipment), please mark it here now — we will prioritize slots and coordinate a single dedicated contact for you.

tom (Facilities): Quick add — the service elevator will be located at Loading Dock C and staffed 07:30–19:00. To book a time slot, fill this short form: https://forms.company/elevator-booking (note: form auto-confirms within 2 business hours).

ajay: Do we have a plan for server-room access? Rack work next Tue morning.

tom (Facilities): @ajay For rack access, facilities staff will escort contractors between 06:30–07:30 and after 18:30. If it's critical during daytime, we can schedule a dedicated escort but need 48h notice and an access form.

lena (People Ops): Also relocating the lactation room to Suite 4B for those dates — signs will be posted and 4B will be stocked. Please DM me to reserve private time if needed.

alvin: I run an onsite workshop Tuesday with ~20 attendees and equipment. Any way to get extra shuttle capacity that day?

marissa (People Ops): @alvin We can add two extra shuttle runs Tuesday morning (07:45 & 09:15) if you confirm headcount by EOD Friday. We'll also arrange a short-term storage cart in the loading dock for gear.

ajay: Will mailroom hours change? I have a FedEx scheduled for Wed 10AM.

tom (Facilities): Mailroom open as usual but any large pallets should go to Dock B after hours. Small packages will still be delivered to the mailroom; they may be routed through the service elevator.

alvin: Cheers. I'll post headcount here tomorrow.

marissa (People Ops): Thanks everyone — we want minimal disruption but want to be deliberate about access. If you need confidential accessibility accommodations, DM me privately. I'll post a final reminder two days before the work starts. :thumbsup:

calendar-bot: Event created: "SF HQ Elevator Modernization" 2026-05-04 — 2026-05-07. Location: Redwood HQ (North Entrance).

lena (People Ops): I'll update the Slack #amenities pinned doc with temporary restroom and lactation locations.

tom (Facilities): Facilities contact on-site for the week: Tom R. (ext 412) — reach via Slack or call 555-0199 after hours.

marissa (People Ops): Final note: if you have vendors or external partners coming that week, please cc facilities on invites so we can coordinate building badges.

ajay: Thanks for the heads up — appreciate the shuttle option.

alvin: :thumbsup:
